commissions.actionError: That action is not available for this commission.

conversions.adjustDisabledNote: This conversion can no longer be adjusted because its commission is not on hold.
conversions.adjustError: Could not apply the adjustment — the commission may no longer be on hold, or the input was invalid.
conversions.adjustIntro: Correct the amount or reassign the conversion to another affiliate. The commission is recalculated from the program rate. Adjustments are only possible while the commission is on hold, and the reason is written to the audit log.
conversions.intro: Reported conversions and the commission each one created, newest first.
conversions.refundError: Could not register the refund. Check the amount and reason.
conversions.refundIntro: Records money returned to the buyer for this order. The commission is clawed back in proportion to the cumulative refunded share of the order; a full refund claws it back entirely.
conversions.title: Conversions

affiliatePayouts.title: My payouts
affiliatePayouts.intro: Every settlement generated for you, with the amounts that were offset against earlier clawbacks.

payouts.title: Payouts
payouts.intro: Generate a settlement to sweep every affiliate’s currently available commissions into one payout (the full available amount, not a calendar slice). Debt from clawed-back payouts is offset inside the payout and formally settled when you mark it paid.
payouts.generated: Settlements generated (affiliates without a payable balance were skipped).
payouts.empty: No payouts yet — generate the first settlement.
payouts.commissionsEmpty: No commissions are attached to this payout.
payouts.markedPaid: Payout marked as paid. The affiliate has been emailed.
payouts.markedFailed: Payout marked as failed. Its commissions are back in the payable pool.
payouts.errorRefRequired: A transfer reference is required to mark a payout as paid.
payouts.errorReasonRequired: A reason is required to mark a payout as failed.
payouts.errorNotPending: This payout is no longer pending.

emails.title: Email log
emails.intro: Every transactional email Summa recorded. With the default log transport nothing leaves the server — rows here are the delivery record; with SMTP transport the status shows sent or failed.
emails.subject: Subject

mail.inviteSubject: You are invited to join {programName} on Summa
mail.inviteBody:
Hi {affiliateName},

You have been invited to join the {programName} affiliate program.

Activate your account and set your password with this one-time link (valid until {expiresAt}):
{activationUrl}

If you were not expecting this invitation, you can ignore this email.
mail.commissionAvailableBody:
Hi {affiliateName},

Good news: {count} commission(s) totalling {amountCents} {currency} just became available in the {programName} program.

They will be included in your next payout.
